items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: all the separation axioms listed in the chapter's definition are stable under composition of morphisms of algebraic spaces (source lines 581-585). The proof is short but structural: for composable f : X -> Y and g : Y -> Z the diagonal Delta_{X/Z} factors as X -> X x_Y X -> X x_Z X; the axiom in question requires the diagonal to have a property P, the second arrow of the factorization also has P because of the fibre product comparison, and the composite of (representable) morphisms with P has P, so Delta_{X/Z} has P and the axiom holds for g o f.
